Primary Target: Persistent synchrotron-like emissions near GRB remnants
Best Observational Instruments: ALMA, VLA, SKA (radio surveys of GRB remnants)
Detection Criteria: Detection of non-thermal radio emissions with atypical linear polarization

Primary Target: High circular polarization in excess of known thermal sources
Detection Criteria: Infrared sources displaying anomalous circular polarization >5%

Primary Target: Unusual gravitational lensing distortions in transient events
Detection Criteria: Optical signals showing excess polarization in strong gravitational fields

Primary Target: Short-lived X-ray flashes with unexpected polarization swings
Detection Criteria: Transient X-ray flashes with time-variable polarization angles

Primary Target: Isolated high-energy bursts exceeding GRB polarization norms
Best Observational Instruments: POLAR-II, Fermi-GBM, CTA (gamma-ray burst polarization analysis)
Detection Criteria: Gamma-ray bursts with polarization exceeding 30% without standard jet alignment
